body:
P2-12 PLAN, START HERE (plan only: no code written; read from main 346883b on 14 Nov 2026; nothing was run and no outside request was made). The compact plan (contract, gate, identity rule, typo rule, callers, slices, closes, tests, rejected options, risks) is the P2-12 section of docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md in the PR "P2-12 plan". The notes after this one carry the long form: 2 slices (what each proves and does not), 3 identity, 4 typo traps, 5 callers with file and line, 6 tests, fixtures and versions.

IN ONE PARAGRAPH. The server gets one catalogue module: ONE gate to Deezer (token bucket, priority, single flight, breaker, a ceiling of 7 outside requests per search; the cover and artist finders move onto it), ONE cache (its own file, never encore.db) and ONE remembered answer to "which catalogue artist is this library artist" (it extends N-15's artist_picture table, keyed by the music server's artist id). Routes under /encore/api/v1/catalogue: search, artists/{id} (identity + popular + releases in one call), artist?libraryArtistId=&name= (the library page), albums/{id}, albums/match, genres; none makes a song ref. The phone gets EncoreCatalogueClient behind the CatalogueClient interface it already has, chosen when info.features lists "catalogue"; the N-14 fix is slice 3; N-23b (typo forgiving on the server) is slice 5 after a drawing; DeezerClient is deleted in slice 7. After it the phone makes no call to Deezer's API; it still loads Deezer's PICTURES from Deezer's picture host (a cover address arrives inside data) until a separate item serves them from the server: never write "the phone no longer calls Deezer" without that.

DECISIONS ASKED OF THE ADVISOR (the default stands until answered; all reversible until slice 2 merges)
D1. A plain music server, or an Encore server without the feature: DEFAULT no catalogue (screens follow capabilities, ADR-R42 point 8; the precedent is D-51 for lyrics; DeezerClient deleted in slice 7, ratchet entry removed). Until slice 7 a plain-server phone keeps DeezerClient (a recorded stop-gap, trigger slice 7). Keeping Deezer on the phone for plain servers for good costs a permanent second catalogue path in the client, which ADR-R38 removes; not offered as an equal option.
D2. The D-51 hold ("nothing of the catalogue merges before b11"). b11 does not exist (RELEASE-CANDIDATE.md B5/B6 "Not started"; the P2-14 server half is held for the same reason). DEFAULT: slices 2 to 8 are built and held as drafts until b11 or the advisor's word; slices 1 (server, additive, nothing calls it) and 4 (a drawing) are mergeable if the hold is lifted for them.
D3. Scope. DEFAULT: split. This item = Deezer on the server, the remembered artist, typos. New item P2-12b = YouTube Music as a second source with its own budget design (a ytmusicapi search per typed query from the Host's address is the burst ADR-R6 and the 22 Oct refusal forbid), MusicBrainz aliases, credits of several artists (F13), the 200-pair labelled set, the server's one ranked list. Textnorm with Arabic is P2-25; ref merges are N-11 (built).
D4. DEFAULT: the identity is keyed by the music server's artist id (not a normalised name), so slices 1 to 4 need nothing from P2-25 and nothing can merge non-Latin artists (B-37). P2-12's Order line is now "Needs: P2-25 [i]" (P2-25 already comes first in order.json; check_order passes; docs/08 regenerated).
D5. DEFAULT: the typo rule is the SHIPPED N-23a rule (under 5 letters never; 5 to 8 one edit; 9 or more two), not the N-23b note's "1 up to 5 letters, 2 longer" (it would recreate B-46). One shared table of cases is run by the Dart and the Python test.

WHAT I NEED FROM THE LEAD: the advisor's answers to D1 to D5; permission for ONE recording run of at most 10 paced requests (tools/record_catalogue_fixtures.py, slice 1), or the word that synthetic fixtures are enough; the board items this plan names (P2-12b, "catalogue pictures come through your server"). No code before a go by SendMessage.
